items.subject: Application | Special Education Teacher, AFIA | Amer AlSaaideh
items.htmlBody:
Dear Al Faisal International Academy Hiring Team,

I am Amer Abdeljalil, a special education teacher and inclusive education coordinator with over five years in Jordanian Ministry of Education schools. I hold an MA in Special Education (Excellent) and I have worked in Qatar as a special education specialist. Al Faisal International Academy is a primary school for Grades 1 to 6.

  • Achieved full inclusion of students with disabilities for the first time in a public school.
  • Led training for general and inclusion teachers on working with students with disabilities, and hold a Cambridge Training of Trainers (TOT) certificate.

I am applying for a Learning Support / Special Education Teacher, Resource Room Teacher or Inclusion Coordinator role. Please find my CV attached.

Kind regards,

Amer Abdeljalil AlSaaideh
Special Education Specialist | Inclusive Education Coordinator
MA in Special Education (Excellent) | 5+ years in Jordan and Qatar
Phone / WhatsApp+962 78 018 9766
Emailamer.abdeljalil77@gmail.com
LinkedInView my LinkedIn profile
Available immediately | Open to relocation

items.htmlBody:
Dear Beverly Hills International School Hiring Team,

I am Amer Abdeljalil, a special education specialist with an MA in Special Education (Excellent) and over five years as a resource room teacher and inclusive education coordinator in Jordanian Ministry of Education schools. I have also worked in Qatar as a special education specialist. BHIS teaches the American curriculum from Early Years to High School.

  • Managed an individual education plan (IEP) for each student, built on formal and informal assessments.
  • Delivered individual learning programmes for students with special needs in Qatar, within a multidisciplinary team.

I am applying for a Learning Support / Special Education Teacher, Resource Room Teacher or Inclusion Coordinator role. Please find my CV attached.
